description: Official document proving residency in a specific district.
required_documents: Proof of Residence (Utility Bill or Allotment Letter)
application_mode: In-person at DC Office / E-Khidmat Markaz
rejection_guidance: If rejected due to address mismatch, ensure your CNIC permanent/temporary address matches the district you are applying from. If not, update CNIC first.
steps: Purchase Domicile file and stamp paper from courts/kutchery.
Fill the form and attach attested copies of documents.
Submit at E-Khidmat Markaz or DC Office.
Collect certificate after processing time (usually 7-14 days).
